recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle any future live search.cfm or searchform work under a resolved later issue rather than reopening this historical DSTU1 ballot request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive 2015 May SDC ballot request to provide search capability across the FHIR DSTU and FHIR Continuous build sites so implementers and ballot reviewers can find specification content.
initial_application: The Jira issue records Grahame Grieve's October 2015 comment that the work was already done. No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-6849 was found; later community and source history show specification search working in 2017 and a build-scope CI search page added in 2019.
additional_context: The same request appears in FHIR-8151 and FHIR-7712, with FHIR-7748 as a duplicate. FHIR-8151 is already represented on the combined branch by a source-changing reconciliation that routes current search links through search-location, and FHIR-11438 is already represented by a no-change audit for a later enable-search request. Later FHIR-50549 and FHIR-54549 live search.cfm reports are unresolved and background only.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch already has source/index.html, the shared navbar, and the shared footer pointing to [%search-location%], and source/search-build.html is included in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml as the active CI search page.
